calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  wo.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) as order_count,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as gross_sales
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(wo.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) as cac_sales,
  SUM(wo.order_total_gross) as total_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wo.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN wo.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) / SUM(wo.order_total_gross), 2) as cac_share_pct
FROM fact_web_order wo
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(wo.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
